# Top Prompts to make ChatGPT write like a human

![Tom Winter](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/aa3b486402b5373030fb440224625e145ee725201cf4b9238dcb40be1e167f88?s=40&d=mm&r=g)[Tom Winter](https://seowind.io/author/seowind/ "Posts by Tom Winter")January 7, 2025

These days, AI is everywhere, helping us with tasks big and small, from writing support and idea generation to casual conversations. But there’s a trick to getting the best out of these AI interactions, especially if you want warm and natural responses. The secret? It’s all about how you prompt the tool.

Considering that, let’s cover the most effective ways to prompt ChatGPT so your exchanges feel more genuine and engaging.

## The quest for authenticity: Why human-like writing matters

![why blog](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Why_blog-1024x229.png)

Authenticity is the ultimate prize when it comes to creating content. As readers, we’re naturally drawn to things that feel real and relatable, even if we know that the words come from an automated writer. That’s why making AI-generated text feel more human-like matters so much. When ChatGPT manages to sound natural, it can actually connect with readers in a way that [builds trust](https://seowind.io/eeat-content/) and keeps them coming back for more.

So, how exactly do we bring out that human touch in ChatGPT’s writing? Doing so requires us to find a sweet spot between AI’s efficiency and the warmth of human communication. By creating prompts that steer ChatGPT toward conversational, authentic language, we can tap into its massive pool of information while still making the content feel personal. This approach improves the reading experience and helps the content shine amid all the generic, mechanical material out there.

In my experience as a content creator, I’ve found that when ChatGPT can whip up something that already sounds genuine, it’s a huge time-saver. I can dive straight into shaping ideas and adding personal insights rather than getting bogged down with rewriting stiff, robotic drafts. This blend of AI-driven speed and human creativity produces content people actually want to read.

At the end of the day, the quest for authenticity in AI content is about creating something valuable for your audience. When ChatGPT writes in a way that feels human, it stirs emotions and engages readers on a deeper level. That emotional pull can be the difference between content that’s glanced over and content that truly resonates. Next, I’ll dig into some practical tips and prompts to help you hit that perfect balance and turn ChatGPT into a real partner in your writing process.

## Essential Basics for Crafting Human-Like Prompts

When it comes to creating prompts to make ChatGPT write like a human, mastering the essentials is crucial. As someone who’s experimented extensively with AI writing, I’ve found that the key lies in understanding how to communicate effectively with the tool. Let’s dive into some fundamental strategies that will help you craft prompts to make ChatGPT sound more human.

### Keep prompts clear

First and foremost is clarity. A well-structured prompt should be specific and detailed. Instead of vague instructions, provide clear guidelines about the tone, style, and content you want. For example, you might write the following, **“Write a blog post about coffee in the style of a passionate barista, using sensory language and personal anecdotes.”** This is far more likely to produce effective and impactful results than a more generic request for content about coffee.

### Include human speech patterns

Next, make sure to incorporate elements of human speech patterns. When crafting prompts to make ChatGPT sound more human, include conversational cues. You could start with something like, **“Imagine you’re chatting with a friend about your favorite books. Write a paragraph describing your top pick, using casual language and personal opinions.”** Context is also crucial for creating human-like content. A strong prompt must include relevant background information. For example: **“You’re a travel blogger who just returned from a trip to Japan. Write a post about your experience, focusing on the unique cultural aspects you encountered.”**

### Prompt creativity

Lastly, don’t forget to encourage creativity and personality in your prompts. You might say, **“Write a product review for a smartphone, but do it in the voice of a sarcastic tech enthusiast who’s seen it all.”** This approach helps ChatGPT [generate content](https://seowind.io/ai-content-generator/) that feels more authentic and less robotic.

By mastering these basic techniques, you’ll possess the core attributes needed to craft [prompts that unlock ChatGPT’s potential](https://seowind.io/chatgpt-seo-prompts/) for human-like writing.

## Use clear and specific prompts

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/AI_blog-1024x229.png)

Clarity and specificity are your best friends when [writing prompts for ChatGPT](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-a-prompt-chatgpt/). [To make ChatGPT write like a human, provide clear and specific prompts while avoiding ambiguity and vagueness](https://seowind.io/how-to-make-chatgpt-write-like-a-human/). This approach ensures that the AI understands precisely what you’re looking for, resulting in more human-like and relevant outputs.

### Contextual information for depth and relevance

Adding context to your prompts is like giving ChatGPT a backstory to work with. Providing relevant background information sets the stage for more nuanced and in-depth responses. For example, instead of simply asking for a product description, you might say, **“Write a product description for a new eco-friendly water bottle, considering the current trend towards sustainability and the [target audience](https://seowind.io/docs/target-audience-what-is-it-and-how-to-define-it/) of environmentally conscious millennials.”**

### Iterate and Refine to make the output better

Prompt writing for ChatGPT is often an iterative process. Don’t expect perfection on the first try. Instead, view each interaction as a stepping stone to better results. If the initial output isn’t what you’re looking for, refine your prompt based on what worked and what didn’t. Consider adding more specific instructions or adjusting the tone to get closer to your desired outcome.

### Remove repetitions and add variety

One telltale sign of [AI-generated content](https://seowind.io/ai-content-generation/) is repetition. To make ChatGPT’s writing more human-like, include instructions in your prompt to avoid repetitive phrases or ideas. You could say, **“Provide diverse examples and use varied sentence structures to explain the concept.”** This encourages ChatGPT to produce more dynamic and engaging content.

### Remove the “fluff” words, phrases, and paragraphs

Humans tend to be more concise and to the point, especially in professional or informative writing. To mimic this, instruct ChatGPT to avoid unnecessary filler content. Your prompt might include something like, **“Write a concise explanation of quantum computing, focusing on key concepts without any fluff or redundant information.”**

### Use Conversational Prompts

To make ChatGPT’s responses sound more human, craft your prompts in a conversational tone. For instance, instead of **“Explain the benefits of meditation,”** you might use a prompt such as, **“Imagine you’re chatting with a friend who’s curious about meditation. How would you casually explain its benefits over a cup of coffee?”**

By providing context and guiding ChatGPT toward the desired style and tone, you’ll obtain more human-like text that will effectively engage readers.

## Advanced Techniques for Enhancing ChatGPT’s Natural Writing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/strategy_blog-1024x229.png)

Now that we’ve established a foundation for writing prompts, it’s time to explore some advanced techniques that can further elevate your AI-generated content. These strategies go beyond basic prompts, helping you create a more authentic and personalized writing experience.

### Create a personalized style guide for a consistent voice and tone

One of the most effective ways to make ChatGPT more human is to develop a personalized style guide, which serves as a blueprint for the AI. Doing so ensures consistency in voice and tone across all generated content. Start by defining key elements of your desired writing style, such as:

- Preferred sentence length and structure
- Vocabulary range (formal, casual, industry-specific)
- Use of idioms or colloquialisms
- Punctuation preferences
- Tone (friendly, professional, humorous, etc.)

Incorporate these guidelines into your prompts and instruct ChatGPT to adhere to your particular style. For example, try, [“Write a blog post](https://seowind.io/ai-blog-post-generator/) about sustainable fashion following these style guidelines: use a friendly tone, incorporate fashion-related idioms, and keep sentences concise.

### Inject personality through conversational prompts and humor

[Customizing directives, such as “Use simple language” or “Write in a conversational tone,” can significantly influence the output.](https://seowind.io/how-to-make-chatgpt-write-like-a-human/) To make ChatGPT more human, try injecting personality into your prompts. Encourage the AI to use a conversational tone and even incorporate humor when appropriate. For instance:

**“Imagine you’re a witty barista explaining the difference between various coffee brewing methods to a curious customer. Write a short, engaging dialogue that includes a couple of coffee-related puns.”**

This approach helps ChatGPT mimic human-to-human interactions when generating content.

### Utilize examples and writing samples for mimicry and learning

[Feeding ChatGPT with diverse writing samples can help it analyze and recreate your style.](https://seowind.io/how-to-make-chatgpt-write-like-a-human/) This technique is especially effective for achieving a consistent and personalized writing style. Here’s how you can implement this:

1. Select a few paragraphs from your previous writings that best represent your desired style.
2. Include these samples in your prompt while asking ChatGPT to analyze and emulate the style.
3. Provide a new topic or content request and instruct the AI to write in the same style as the samples.

For example:

**“Here are two paragraphs from my recent blog posts: \[Insert samples\]. Analyze the writing style, including tone, sentence structure, and vocabulary. Now, write a new paragraph about the benefits of meditation, mimicking this style as closely as possible.”**

By using these advanced techniques, you can significantly enhance ChatGPT’s ability to produce human-like content that aligns with your unique voice and style. Remember, always provide clear guidance and consistent examples, and encourage a natural, conversational tone in your prompts.

## Practical examples of prompts to make ChatGPT write like a human

Let me share some real-world examples of prompts that can help ChatGPT write more like a human. These examples are designed to showcase how you can effectively communicate with the AI to produce content that feels authentic and engaging.

### Prompt for Blog Post Introduction

“Write an engaging introduction for a blog post about sustainable gardening. Use a conversational tone, as if you’re chatting with a friend over coffee. Include a personal anecdote about your first attempt at growing vegetables and how it sparked your interest in sustainability. Keep the paragraphs short and punchy, with a mix of sentence lengths to maintain a natural flow.”

### Prompt for Product Description

“Craft a product description for a high-end coffee maker, written from the perspective of a passionate barista. Use sensory language to describe the aroma and taste of the coffee it produces. Incorporate some coffee-related jargon, but explain it in a way that’s accessible to the average consumer. Add a touch of humor by playfully addressing common frustrations with inferior coffee makers.”

### Prompt for Social Media Post \[Twitter\]

“Create a Twitter thread (5 tweets) explaining the basics of cryptocurrency to a complete beginner. Use simple analogies and everyday language. Avoid technical jargon, and if you must use a complex term, explain it immediately. Inject a casual, friendly tone as if you’re explaining it to a curious friend at a party. End with a lighthearted joke about the volatility of crypto markets.”

### Prompt for Email Newsletter

“Write the opening paragraph of an email newsletter for a fitness studio. Address the reader directly, using ‘you’ to create a personal connection. Start with a question that resonates with common fitness struggles. Then, transition into an empathetic response that introduces this month’s fitness challenge. Use an encouraging tone, but avoid being overly pushy or salesy.”

### Prompt for Movie Review

“Compose a brief movie review for the latest superhero blockbuster. Write as if you’re recommending it to a friend who’s skeptical about the genre. Balance your enthusiasm for the spectacular effects with honest critiques of any plot holes or overused tropes. Use colorful language to describe the most exciting scenes, and throw in a pop culture reference or two to add personality.”

These examples demonstrate how a prompt for ChatGPT can incorporate specific instructions about tone, style, and content structure. By providing clear guidance and encouraging a more natural, conversational approach, you can help the tool generate content that feels less robotic and more authentically human.

As you experiment with these prompts, you’ll better understand how to communicate effectively with ChatGPT, resulting in increasingly human-like outputs.

## Sample prompt on how to write in your brand voice

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Article_writing_blog-1024x229.png)

Developing a [consistent brand voice](https://seowind.io/brand-tone-of-voice/) is crucial for maintaining a strong identity across all your content. When using ChatGPT to generate content, provide clear instructions that capture the essence of your brand’s tone and style. **Here’s a sample prompt** that demonstrates how to guide ChatGPT in writing with your specific brand voice:

**“For this task, I want you to write in our brand’s unique voice. Our brand is a tech startup that creates innovative smart home devices. Here are the key characteristics of our brand voice:**

1. **Tone: Friendly and approachable, but also knowledgeable and confident.**
2. **Language: Use simple, jargon-free language to explain complex tech concepts. Imagine you’re explaining things to a tech-curious friend.**
3. **Sentence structure: Mix short, punchy sentences with longer, more detailed ones for rhythm.**
4. **Humor: Incorporate subtle humor, especially when discussing common smart home frustrations.**
5. **Metaphors: Use relatable metaphors to explain tech features, often drawing parallels with everyday objects or experiences.**
6. **Call-to-action: End with an encouraging, low-pressure CTA emphasizing how our products can improve daily life.**

**Write a short [blog post introduction](https://seowind.io/blog-post-introduction/) (about 100 words) announcing our new smart thermostat. Highlight its energy-saving features and user-friendly interface. Remember to incorporate all the elements of our brand voice mentioned above.”**

This prompt provides ChatGPT with a clear roadmap for capturing your brand’s unique voice. It outlines specific aspects of tone, language use, and structural preferences, giving the AI a comprehensive guide. By including examples of how to approach certain elements (like using metaphors or incorporating humor), you set up ChatGPT for success when mimicking your brand’s distinctive style.

You can adjust this template to fit a specific brand voice, adding or modifying elements as needed. Be as detailed and specific as possible and provide ChatGPT with all the information it needs to generate content that aligns perfectly with your brand identity.

## Sample prompt for adjusting perplexity and burstiness

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Optimize_blog-1024x229.png)

When attempting to make ChatGPT’s output more human-like, you’ll need to consider factors like perplexity and burstiness in your writing.

### Perplexity

Let’s break this down: perplexity is like a barometer for how well a language model “gets” the flow of a sentence or passage. Think of it as the model’s surprise meter. If the perplexity is low, it means the model finds the text predictable. It’s kind of like finishing someone’s sentence when you already know what they’re about to say. But if perplexity is high, it’s like the model is scratching its head, unsure what’s coming next. Ideally, you want it somewhere in the middle. Too predictable? It feels dull and robotic. Too unpredictable? It’s chaotic and confusing.

#### Why It Matters for Human-like Writing

Humans have this knack for mixing predictability with just enough creativity to keep things interesting. Writing that’s too obvious can feel boring, while overly unpredictable writing is, well, a mess. For AI to hit that sweet spot, it needs to balance these two, so the text feels natural, like something a person might actually write.

### Burstiness

Here’s a fun one: burstiness is all about variety in how sentences look and feel. Picture a conversation with a friend. They might say something long-winded and detailed, then hit you with a quick, snappy comment. That’s burstiness! It’s the natural ebb and flow of sentence length, structure, and complexity that gives writing its rhythm.

#### Why It Matters for Human-like Writing

When AI churns out sentences that are all the same length or style, it feels…off. Humans don’t write like that. We mix it up, long rambles followed by brief statements or questions. By embracing burstiness, AI-generated text can avoid that stiff, mechanical vibe and instead feel lively and engaging. It’s like giving the writing a bit of a heartbeat.

### Why These Concepts Are Key

When you put perplexity and burstiness together, they’re like the secret recipe for making AI-written text feel genuinely human.

- **Perplexity** makes sure the text stays coherent and logical—it’s the part that ensures the writing “makes sense.”
- **Burstiness** injects that natural rhythm and flow, so the words don’t sound like they came from a robot.

For example, a human writer might open with a sprawling, introspective sentence that paints a vivid picture, then follow it with a quick zinger to drive the point home. AI that nails both perplexity and burstiness could replicate this kind of dynamic writing, making its output not just readable but relatable.

### How do perplexity and burstiness relate to prompts?

Using prompts that describe human writing characteristics, such as perplexity and burstiness, can help decrease AI detection scores. These elements add a layer of unpredictability and variation typical in human writing. **Here’s a sample prompt** that demonstrates how to guide ChatGPT in adjusting these aspects:

**“I want you to write a short blog post about the benefits of meditation. As you write, please incorporate the following characteristics to make the writing more human-like:**

1. **Perplexity: Vary the complexity of your sentences and ideas. Mix simple, straightforward statements with more intricate thoughts. This creates a more natural flow that mimics human thought processes.**
2. **Burstiness: Alternate between clusters of longer, more detailed sentences and short, punchy ones. This creates a rhythm that feels more organic and less predictable.**
3. **Vocabulary diversity: Use a range of words, from common to occasionally more sophisticated, but ensure they’re contextually appropriate.**
4. **Personal touch: Include a brief anecdote or personal reflection to add authenticity.**
5. **Conversational elements: Incorporate rhetorical questions or direct addresses to the reader to enhance engagement.**

**Please write about 200-250 words, keeping these elements in mind. Start with a hook that draws the reader in, then explore 2-3 main benefits of meditation, and conclude with a thought-provoking statement or question.”**

This prompt guides ChatGPT to create content that feels more natural and less formulaic. By explicitly asking for varied sentence structures, diverse vocabulary, and a mix of simple and complex ideas, you’re encouraging the AI tool to produce text more closely resembling human writing patterns.

Experiment with different combinations of these elements to find the right balance for your needs and audience. As you refine your prompts, you’ll see a noticeable improvement in how human-like and engaging your AI-generated content becomes.

## Sample prompt on how to write sentences like human

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/idea_blog-1024x229.png)

In order to craft sentences that sound genuinely human, your focus should be on capturing the nuances and imperfections of natural language. **Here’s a sample prompt** designed to guide ChatGPT in creating more human-like sentences:

**“I want you to write a short paragraph about the joys of traveling. As you write, focus on creating sentences that sound like they’re coming from a real person. Here are some guidelines to follow:**

1. **Vary sentence length: Mix short, punchy sentences with longer, more complex ones. This creates a natural rhythm in your writing.**
2. **Use contractions: Incorporate contractions like ‘it’s,’ ‘don’t,’ or ‘we’re’ to make the language feel more conversational.**
3. **Add filler words sparingly: Occasionally use words like ‘well,’ ‘you know,’ or ‘actually’ to mimic natural speech patterns, but don’t overdo it.**
4. **Include personal opinions: Express subjective thoughts or feelings using phrases like ‘I think’ or ‘in my experience.’**
5. **Make subtle mistakes: Add a minor grammatical error or a slightly awkward phrase that a human might naturally make, then correct or rephrase it as if you’re thinking out loud.**
6. **Use analogies or metaphors: Incorporate a relatable comparison to explain a concept or feeling.**
7. **Show hesitation or uncertainty: Use phrases like ‘maybe,’ ‘probably,’ or ‘I’m not entirely sure, but…’ to reflect human doubt.**

_**Write about 150 words, keeping these elements in mind. Start with an attention-grabbing opening sentence and end with a thought that leaves the reader pondering about their own travel experiences.”**_

This prompt encourages ChatGPT to move away from perfectly structured, robotic sentences and instead create content that feels more organic and human. By incorporating elements like varied sentence structures, conversational language, and even subtle imperfections, the resulting text is more likely to resemble something written by a person.

Remember, the key to writing sentences like a human is embracing the natural flow and occasional quirks of human communication. As you experiment with this prompt, you may find that the output becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from human-written content, achieving that authentic touch we often seek in AI-generated text.

## Templates and examples for transforming ChatGPT into your personal writer

Here are some templates and examples to help you get started:

### Blog Post Template:

Topic: \[Insert topic\]

Tone: \[Specify desired tone, e.g., casual, professional, humorous\]

Target audience: \[Describe your readers\] Key points to cover:

– \[Point 1\]

– \[Point 2\]

– \[Point 3\]

Word count: \[Specify desired length\]

Additional instructions: \[Any specific requirements or preferences\]

[Write a blog post](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-a-blog-post-fast-ai/) that engages the reader from the start, covers the critical points in a logical flow, and concludes with a call-to-action or thought-provoking question.

### Blog Post Example:

Topic: The benefits of a plant-based diet

Tone: Friendly and informative

Target audience: Health-conscious individuals aged 25-40

Key points to cover:

– Environmental impact

– Health benefits

– Easy ways to incorporate more plant-based meals

Word count: 800 words

Additional instructions: Include personal anecdotes and practical tips. Use a conversational style as if explaining to a friend. Write a blog post that engages the reader from the start, covers the key points in a logical flow, and concludes with a call-to-action or thought-provoking question.

### Social Media Post Template:

Platform: \[Specify platform, e.g., Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn\]

Post type: \[e.g., informational, promotional, engaging question\]

Topic: \[Insert topic\] Tone: \[Specify desired tone\]

Character limit: \[If applicable\] Hashtags to include: \[List relevant hashtags\]

Create a \[platform\] post that captures attention quickly and encourages engagement. Include emojis if appropriate for the platform and topic.

### Social Media Post Example:

Post type: Engaging question

Topic: Remote work productivity tips

Tone: Friendly and curious

Character limit: 280 characters.

Hashtags to include: #RemoteWork #ProductivityTips

Create a Twitter post that captures attention quickly and encourages engagement. Include emojis if appropriate for the platform and topic.

### Product Description Template:

Product: \[Name of product\]

Target audience: \[Describe ideal customer\]

Key features: – \[Feature 1\] – \[Feature 2\] – \[Feature 3\]

Tone: \[Specify desired tone, e.g., enthusiastic, professional\]

Word count: \[Specify desired length\]

Additional instructions: \[Any specific requirements or preferences\]

Write a compelling product description that highlights the key features and benefits, addressing the needs and desires of the target audience. Use sensory language where appropriate and include a clear call-to-action.

### Product Description Example:

Product: EcoBreeze Portable Fan

Target audience: Eco-conscious consumers who enjoy outdoor activities

Key features: – Solar-powered with 12-hour battery life – Compact and lightweight design – Three speed settings with oscillation function

Tone: Enthusiastic and eco-friendly

Word count: 200 words

Additional instructions: Emphasize the product’s sustainability and versatility. Use vivid language to describe the cooling experience. Write a compelling product description highlighting the key features and benefits, addressing the needs and desires of the target audience. Use sensory language where appropriate and include a clear call-to-action.

These templates and examples provide a framework for transforming ChatGPT into your personal writer. By customizing these prompts to fit your specific needs and style preferences, you can guide the AI to produce authentic content tailored to your voice. Remember to experiment with different instructions and refine your prompts based on the results you receive.

## Tips for iterative experimentation: From basic adjustments to advanced fine-tuning

If your top priority is finding or crafting the perfect prompt for ChatGPT to avoid AI detection, your best approach takes the form of iterative experimentation. This process involves making gradual adjustments and refinements to your prompts, allowing you to fine-tune the output until it closely resembles human-written content. Here are some tips to guide you through this experimental journey:

01. **Start with a baseline:** Begin with a simple, straightforward prompt and analyze the output. This gives you a starting point for comparison as you make adjustments.
02. **Adjust one element at a time:** When experimenting with your prompt to avoid AI detection, change only one aspect of your instructions at a time. This could be the tone, sentence structure, or level of detail. By isolating variables, you can more easily identify which changes have the most significant impact.
03. **Incorporate human-like elements gradually:** Start by adding basic human-like qualities to your prompts, such as requesting more varied sentence lengths or using contractions. As you become more comfortable, progress to more advanced techniques like asking for personal anecdotes or subtle opinions.
04. **Analyze and learn from each iteration:** After each attempt, carefully review the output. Look for ways to improve and any remaining AI-like patterns. Use these observations to inform your next prompt adjustment.
05. **Experiment with different writing styles:** Try prompts that mimic various human writing styles, from casual blog posts to formal academic papers. This versatility can help you [avoid detection](https://seowind.io/how-to-bypass-ai-detection/) across different types of content.
06. **Use perplexity and burstiness:** Incorporate instructions that encourage varied complexity (perplexity) and rhythm (burstiness). This makes the output feel more organic and less predictable.
07. **Refine your brand voice**: If you’re aiming for a specific brand voice, iteratively adjust your prompts to better capture its nuances. This might involve fine-tuning the level of formality, use of industry jargon, or incorporation of brand-specific phrases.
08. **Test with AI detection tools:** Regularly run your outputs through AI detection tools. This can help you identify which prompt adjustments are most effective at avoiding detection.
09. **Seek human feedback:** Always have human readers review the content. Their insights can be invaluable for identifying areas where the writing still feels artificial.
10. **Keep a prompt library:** As you discover effective prompts, save them in a personal library. This allows you to build on successful strategies and quickly access proven templates for future use.

The goal of using a prompt to avoid AI detection isn’t deception but rather to create content that feels natural and engaging to human readers. Similarly, the iterative process is not just about avoiding detection; it’s about honing your skills to produce valuable and human-like content.
